Coram : R. BANUMATHI*, INDIRA BANERJEE
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996: ss. 11(6), 21 and 25 (a) – Appointment of arbitrator – Contract between appellant-contractor and respondent-State – Dispute between the parties – Contractor requested appointment of arbitrator – State appointed arbitrator in terms of arbitration clause (clause 65 of General Conditions of Contract) – Contractor did not participate in arbitration proceedings – The proceedings terminated u/s. 25(a) – Contractor being aggrieved by appointment of the arbitrator, filed petition u/s. 11(6)
Decision Date : 04-12-2018 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 11824/2018 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
